先分清单态 BdG 的 Nambu 冗余，再转到 NS 的 (e↑,h↓) 块与: Separate singlet BdG Nambu redundancy before moving to the NS (e↑,h↓) block and charge flux. Explicitly assign the arbitrary energy scale in eV and recheck the particle–hole matrix; do not count spin twice.
先建立 1−Ree+Rhe 的电荷账本，再仅令同一器件 Δ=0 得到正常参考；固: Build the 1−Ree+Rhe charge ledger before setting only Δ=0 in the same device for a normal reference. Keep contacts and η fixed when testing doubling; a finite-energy spectrum is not a self-consistent finite-bias I(V).
先固定单变量正常参考，再配对 E 与 −E 的电子/空穴入射并计入 η 吸收，核: Fix the single-variable normal reference before pairing electron/hole incidence at E and −E and including η absorption in the quasiparticle flux balance. Do not fill threshold gaps with zero; converge η and the energy step separately.
先按同一原胞平移求实空间位点轨道与稳定子，再附加局域轨道构造 Bloch 纤维；: Find real-space site orbits and stabilizers using the same primitive translations, then attach local orbitals to build the Bloch fiber. Site count times local dimension is not mechanical 3N counting and does not automatically define an EBR.
保留同一组有序位点和局域基，把折回原胞的整格余量放入同一周期规范的 Bloch: Keep the ordered sites and local basis and restore the cell-folding lattice remainders in the same periodic Bloch gauge. If the rotated k is not equivalent to the original k, the map is not a symmetry label within one fiber.
先保存 Seitz 代表元相乘的整格缺陷和 k 相位，再用同一因子系统的小表示字: Retain the lattice defect and k phase from multiplying Seitz representatives before reducing with small-representation characters for the same factor system. Projective two-dimensionality at a boundary need not come from spin or time reversal.
先会分解固定 k 的小群表示，再把端点表示限制到线上共同操作；保持设置、规范和因: Reduce a fixed-k little-group representation before restricting endpoint representations to the common line operations. Match the setting, gauge and factor system; do not copy three-dimensional orbital numbers directly into the two-dimensional C4v model.
先确定线上实际保留的镜面和分支本征值，再检验禁止混合与破缺开隙；不同标签允许交叉: Identify the mirror actually retained on the line and its branch eigenvalues before testing forbidden mixing and gap opening. Different labels permit but do not force an energy crossing, and parent labels are not exact labels of symmetry-broken mixed states.
先分清双值镜面平方、时间反演平方和 TRIM，再加入半平移的端点配对；一般 k: Distinguish the squares of the double-valued mirror and time reversal and identify TRIM before adding half-translation endpoint pairing. A generic-k partner lies at −k; single-valued endpoint pairing is not automatically spin Kramers degeneracy.
先用位点置换和整格余量构造无自旋 Bloch 矩阵，再加入自旋提升；群4沿 z: Build the spinless Bloch matrix from site permutations and lattice remainders before adding the spin lift. Group 4 uses fractional k_z along z, while the line model uses radian k_x=2πf_x along x; do not mix their phases.
先核实半平移、自旋平方及动量不变条件，再在简并能量子空间内求操作标签和端点伙伴；: Verify the half translation, spin-square relation and momentum-invariance condition before finding operation labels and endpoint partners inside degenerate energy subspaces. Operation-eigenvalue curves are not energy dispersions.
先列出伙伴交换的空间与反幺正条件，再一次删除一个约束检查全线能隙和端点；保留 K: List the spatial and antiunitary conditions for partner switching before removing one constraint at a time and checking the whole-line gap and endpoints. Kramers endpoints do not ensure middle-band connectivity, and a line direct gap is not a three-dimensional insulating gap.
先把保持单个 q 的小群同改变星臂的操作分开，再用 ±q 共轭配对构造实模式；本: Separate the little group retaining one q from operations changing star arms, then pair ±q conjugates to build real modes. This experiment uses a scalar field on a finite square lattice, not a general three-dimensional displacement representation.
先声明完整星及真正非零的 Fourier 分量，再求当前图案的稳定子与平移子群；: Specify the full star and the Fourier components actually nonzero before finding the pattern stabilizer and its translation subgroup. A compatible rectangular supercell need not be a minimal oblique cell, and its area need not equal the translation index.
先按同一 ±q 和 Fourier 约定把余弦幅度转成复系数，再比较相位和强度；: Convert cosine amplitudes to complex coefficients using the same ±q and Fourier conventions before comparing phases and intensities. A²/4 does not apply when a self-conjugate arm is counted twice, and scalar intensity is not experimental diffraction intensity.
先固定厄米生成元、矩阵指数和对易子中的 i，再用 T_a=λ_a/2 构造三能级: Fix Hermitian generators, matrix exponentials and the i in commutators before constructing three-level SU(3) with T_a=λ_a/2. Convert interface degrees to radians; eight generators do not imply eight state amplitudes.
先明确三分量态和 T3、T8 的对角矩阵，再画共同本征值与升算符连接的权差；叠加: Specify the three-component state and diagonal T3 and T8 matrices before plotting simultaneous eigenvalues and weight differences connected by raising operators. A superposition can keep the same mean weight while its relative phase changes.
先分清权、根与权平均，再用最高权 (p,q) 标记不可约类型并保留坐标重数；GT: Distinguish weights, roots and mean weights before labeling irreducible types by highest weight (p,q) and retaining coordinate multiplicities. Convert integer GT H1,H2 to T3,T8; zero-weight multiplicity differs from outer multiplicity.
先数清类型、维数、权与外重数，再把 (R,α,μ) 落实为 CG 矩阵的列；列是: Count types, dimensions, weights and outer multiplicities before assigning (R,α,μ) to CG columns. Columns expand coupled states in the product basis, so product-to-coupled coordinates use C†, not multiplication of probability tables.
先固定列展开、复共轭和 GT 约定，再从交换对称与迹不变构造 3⊗3、3⊗3̄；: Fix column expansions, conjugation and the GT convention before constructing 3⊗3 and 3⊗3̄ from exchange symmetry and trace invariance. Transform the phases of the anti-fundamental basis (s̄,−d̄,ū) together with the generators.
先在 3⊗3 用交换算符区分对称与反对称通道，再处理 8⊗8 的两份等价八重态；: Use exchange to separate symmetric and antisymmetric channels in 3⊗3 before treating the two equivalent octets in 8⊗8. Rotate state coordinates and the exchange operator consistently when changing the copy basis; these copies are not internal zero-weight states.
先用 Dynkin 加框分清 10⊗3 的 15′ 与 15，再在同权块用降算符: Use Dynkin box addition to distinguish 15′ and 15 in 10⊗3 before constructing radicals by lowering and orthogonality within one weight block. Exact CG is bounded by N≤81 and numerical CG by N≤256; radicals are not guessed from decimals.
先掌握二元 CG 的副本标签，再分别保留两个顶点的外重数来构造三体路径；Raca: Understand binary CG copy labels before retaining the outer multiplicities at both vertices of a triple-product path. Racah matrix size is set by final-irrep multiplicity; the triple interface allows only external factors with p+q≤2.
先从同一最终内部态的嵌入求 F=V_R†V_L，再手算三个 3 的精确重叠；维数: Obtain F=V_R†V_L from embeddings of the same final internal state before deriving exact overlaps for three 3s. Dimension-reduced S=F/√(dE dF) obeys weighted orthogonality; state conversion still uses F.
先按二元顶点枚举三体路径，再扩展到四体的三个顶点副本，并把右树 ACBD 重排为: Enumerate triple-product paths vertex by vertex before extending to the three vertex-copy labels of four factors. Reorder the right tree from ACBD to ABCD before overlaps; this step does not automatically attach a fermionic exchange sign.
先统一因子次序和所有副本标签，再手算四个 3 的 3×3 R；9j 缩约权重是两: Align factor order and all copy labels before deriving the 3×3 R for four 3s. The reduced 9j weights are products of two leaf-branch dimensions; S obeys weighted orthogonality and cannot replace R in state conversion.
先按 (p,q)、共轭和 Casimir 分清 15 与 15′，再分别记四个输: Distinguish 15 and 15′ by (p,q), conjugation and Casimir before recording the four inputs, final root and each vertex copy separately. The four-factor bound N≤4096 does not permit arbitrary four high-dimensional factors.
先在同一基底中检查表示乘法与特征标，再分清晶体点群、位点稳定子和保持指定波矢的小: First check representation multiplication and characters in one consistent basis, then distinguish the crystal point group, a site stabilizer and the little group of a specified wavevector; the full point-group table does not generally apply at arbitrary k.
先保留非 Γ 点的小群与平移相位，再同步变换基底、原点和倒坐标；BC/Bilba: First retain the little group and translation phases away from Gamma, then transform the basis, origin and reciprocal coordinates together. Align operations and characters for BC/Bilbao labels; do not copy the input k unchanged or use ordinary structure conversion for magnetic structures.
先分清何时需要半整数自旋的双值表示，再用旋量振幅、概率和 Bloch 向量分别检: First identify when half-integer spin requires double-valued representations, then compare spinor amplitudes, probabilities and the Bloch vector under 2pi and 4pi rotations; a classical arrow cannot display an overall minus sign.
先算出自旋半周矩阵平方为 −I，再把这个 2π 负号保留为中心元 Ē；用 C₂: First square a spin-half half-turn matrix to obtain minus I, then retain that 2pi sign as the central element bar E; use the four-element lift of C2 to test why a double group is not obtained by copying the original table.
先用 Ē 的乘法关系理解中心元，再按 D(Ē)=±I 区分单值与双值扇区；轨: First understand the multiplication of the central element bar E, then distinguish single- and double-valued sectors by D(bar E)=plus or minus I; neither multiplicity nor dimension in an orbital-spin product directly specifies the SOC energy degeneracy.
先会对字符作共轭加权内积并检验重数与总维数，再在完整四元素 C₄（C₂ 双群）上: First reduce characters with the conjugated weighted inner product and check multiplicities and total dimension, then reduce p tensor spin element by element in the complete four-element C4, the C2 double group; three copies of a one-dimensional irrep are not a protected threefold energy level.
先由一个 C₂ 的提升确定 g²=Ē，再把三个正交二重轴共同提升并比较 XY: First establish g squared equals bar E for one lifted C2, then lift three orthogonal half-turn axes together and compare XY with YX; retaining the central sign reveals the noncommutativity of Q8.
先保留两个半周自旋旋转留下的 Ē，再与螺旋平方的整胞平移相乘；中心负号与 Bl: First retain bar E from two spin half-turns, then multiply it by the full-cell translation from a squared screw; the central sign and the Bloch phase have different origins. The current experiment lifts proper rotations only; inversion and mirrors require separately specified lift conventions.
先在螺旋轴保持的 k 子空间保留单值 Bloch 相位，再加入自旋中心负号，对照: First retain the single-valued Bloch phase in a k subspace preserved by the screw, then add the central spinor sign and compare double-valued eigenvalues at Gamma and the axial boundary. Use fractional k_z; an eigenvalue relation alone does not prove energy degeneracy.
先掌握普通表示在同一基底下的乘法和相似变换，再显式加入 K，推导反幺正乘法与 S: First understand multiplication and similarity transformations of ordinary representations in one basis, then include K explicitly to derive antiunitary multiplication and the basis change S inverse U S conjugate; the trace of an antiunitary matrix part is not an ordinary character for reduction.
先用 iK 算出反幺正平方必须是 UU*，再对自旋 1/2 的 Θ 验证 −I: First use iK to establish that an antiunitary square is U U conjugate, then verify minus I and an orthogonal partner for spin-half time reversal; equal energy and same-k pairing additionally require Hamiltonian symmetry and return to the same momentum subspace.
先逐位点同时匹配化学位置和时间奇轴向磁矩，再用实际保留的纯 Θ、反平移和酉平移晶: First match chemical sites and time-odd axial moments at every site, then distinguish the four magnetic-space-group types using actual pure time reversal, antitranslations and the unitary translation lattice; zero net magnetization does not replace those checks.
先区分IV类的反平移与酉磁平移，再观察忘去平移后 ΘTτ 如何只剩 Θ；灰磁点群: First distinguish a type-IV antitranslation from unitary magnetic translations, then see how forgetting translations maps Theta T tau to Theta; a gray magnetic point group's constraints on uniform properties do not recover local staggered order or momentum-dependent phases.
先用明确的 P、p 同时变换操作、原点和倒坐标，再阅读BNS/OG标识符；编号对: First transform operations, origin and reciprocal coordinates with explicit P and p, then read BNS and OG identifiers; a correspondence between identifiers does not itself supply a structure transformation, and ordinary BC/Bilbao labels are not magnetic-corepresentation labels.
先识别指标二的酉子群 H 与反幺正陪集 aH，再研究 a 如何联结H表示及其伙伴: First identify the index-two unitary subgroup H and antiunitary coset aH, then study how a links an H representation to its partner and use a squared and complex conjugation to test any enlargement; a corepresentation is not assembled by appending primed character rows.
先分开检查反幺正平方、Hamiltonian 对称与同一 k 返回，再将 Θ 换: First check the antiunitary square, Hamiltonian symmetry and return to the same k separately, then replace Theta by Theta T tau. The one-dimensional axial model uses magnetic reciprocal fractions and cannot represent a transverse three-dimensional counterexample; a square of minus I does not remove the momentum condition.
先由保持磁序的酉平移确定磁晶胞，并确认 τ不是酉平移而2τ是，再在这个磁倒格坐标: First determine the magnetic cell from unitary translations preserving the order and verify that tau is not one of them but 2tau is, then square Theta T tau in that magnetic reciprocal basis; k coordinates of chemical and magnetic cells cannot be interchanged numerically.
先把真实晶格平移保留为 exp(−2πik·L)，再为反平移平方重新选用酉磁晶格: First retain a true lattice translation as exp(-2pi i k dot L), then use the unitary magnetic lattice and its translation 2tau when squaring an antitranslation; check the Bloch phase separately from the antiunitary momentum action before inferring pairing.
先用统一颜色置换求保色核与像，再把同一方法用于三维周期平移；三次循环后留下整胞平: First find the color-preserving kernel and image of a global color permutation, then apply the same method to three-dimensional translations; three cycles leave a full-cell translation, and only the quotient by the color-preserving translations has three elements.
先掌握颜色置换同态与保色核，再换用允许非平凡二色交换的母群求指标二的核；不能把: First understand the color-permutation homomorphism and its kernel, then change to a parent group admitting a nontrivial two-color exchange and find its index-two kernel. A C3 generator cannot simply be changed into a two-color swap, and linear color exchange cannot replace time reversal with complex conjugation.
先逐位点检查磁空间操作的轴向磁矩变换，再放松SOC锁定、把磁矩旋转U与位置旋转R: First check the axial-moment action of a magnetic spatial operation at every site, then relax SOC locking and record spin rotation U separately from position rotation R; a selected domain's combined stabilizer is not the Hamiltonian's full global spin-rotation symmetry.
先分别追踪位置的R作用与磁矩的U作用并逐站点匹配，再加入Seitz平移复合；去掉: First track R on positions and U on magnetic moments and check every site, then add Seitz translation composition; retain the spin factor when projecting away translations, and retain full-cell translations even when the displayed motif wraps back.
先把位置搬运与自旋旋转分开检验，再固定所有站点求 Umi=mi；用磁矩张成空间的: First separate site motion from spin rotation, then hold every site fixed and solve Umi=mi for all moments. Use the rank of their span to distinguish the collinear SO(2) stabilizer from noncollinear unitary stabilizers; the current SO(3) output does not include the antiunitary part of generalized O(3).
先逐站点验证[C₂x∥C₂z]保持两站点磁序，再对同一个U和R分别检查不带与带时: First verify site by site that [C2x parallel C2z] preserves the two-site magnetic pattern, then test the same U and R against the locking conditions with and without time reversal; pattern matching does not replace either operation locking or a Hamiltonian symmetry check.
先在正交笛卡尔基底中逐位点变换时间奇轴向磁矩，再写成 U=(−1)^εdet(R: First transform each time-odd axial moment in an orthonormal Cartesian basis, then write the locking condition U=(-1)^epsilon det(Rc)Rc. Match chemical sites and target moments, retain the time-reversal branch, and check Hamiltonian symmetry separately.
先把动力学矩阵本征值认作 ω²，并由质量加权本征矢还原位移，再判断负本征值；Ph: First identify dynamical-matrix eigenvalues as omega squared and recover displacements from mass-weighted eigenvectors before interpreting negative eigenvalues. Negative Phonopy display values encode imaginary modes; freezing a finite-q mode still requires masses, complex phases and a compatible supercell.
先区分驻点、曲率与全局最低自由能，再把虚频解释为指定参考态的局部负曲率线索；无量: First distinguish stationary points, curvature and the global free-energy minimum, then interpret an imaginary mode as evidence of local negative curvature at a specified reference state. Dimensionless Landau Q is not a normalized phonon coordinate; one negative mode does not determine the final phase or transition temperature.
先在同一常规胞中按复振幅相加再求模平方，再分解格心和化学基底因子；改变恒定实元素: First add complex amplitudes in the same conventional cell before taking the modulus squared, then separate centering and chemical-basis factors. Vary the constant real species weights to distinguish centering-enforced absences, identical-species basis zeros and accidental cancellation in the current model.
先用正指数散射振幅追踪位置相位，再同时检查 Rᵀh=h 与半平移相位；2₁(z): First track positional phases using the positive-exponent diffraction amplitude, then check R transpose h=h together with the fractional-translation phase. The 00l condition for 2_1(z) and the 0kl condition for an x-normal c glide do not apply to all hkl; not forbidden does not guarantee a nonzero amplitude.
先建立相容晶胞、同种原子一一对应和周期最短位移，并分开均匀应变与内位移，再用母相: First establish compatible cells, one-to-one matching of chemical species and nearest periodic displacements, separating homogeneous strain from internal motion, then project in the parent Cartesian metric. Modes use ordinary Euclidean normalization and amplitudes in angstrom, not mass-weighted phonon coordinates.
先声明几何模式的基底、归一化和重构残差，再另建双序参量竞争自由能；几何幅度用 Å: First state the geometric mode basis, normalization and reconstruction residual, then build a separate two-order-parameter competition free energy. Geometric amplitudes are in angstrom, whereas Landau Q is independently dimensionless; a small residual neither fits energy coefficients nor establishes a standard irrep basis.
先检查一变量自由能的有界性、全部驻点、曲率和能量，再推广到双变量 Hessian: First check boundedness, all stationary points, curvature and energies in one variable, then extend to the two-variable Hessian, axial and mixed branches, and continuous degeneracy. Retain the normalization of each polynomial coefficient; a mixed stationary point or a low plotted pixel does not establish global stability.
先在固定静水压力下对同一输入胞的 E+Fvib+pV 求有效内点极小，再对最小化: First find a valid interior minimum of E+Fvib+pV per input cell at fixed hydrostatic pressure, then differentiate the minimized G and V to obtain alpha_V and Cp. Use eV per input cell and angstrom cubed; fixed-volume Cv cannot simply be relabeled Cp.
先理解响应依赖自由能拟合及一、二阶微分，再检查体积边界、残差、窗口、温度邻点与分: First understand how responses depend on free-energy fitting and first and second derivatives, then check volume boundaries, residuals, windows, neighboring temperatures and branch changes. Missing alpha_V or Cp at endpoint temperatures or invalid minima must not be filled with zero, and differentiation must not silently cross phase branches.
先辨认谐性负曲率、数值声学伪虚频与非谐边界，再核查各体积是否属于同一稳定相的准谐: First distinguish harmonic negative curvature, numerical acoustic artifacts and anharmonic limits, then check whether all volumes follow one stable-phase quasiharmonic path. A well-fitted total free-energy table contains no mode-resolved information and cannot establish the absence of imaginary modes or dynamical stability.
先识别均匀双阱的两个等价极小，再加入梯度代价、固定两端和中心约束建立标量壁；须重: First identify the two equivalent minima of a uniform double well, then add a gradient cost, fixed endpoints and a center constraint to define a scalar wall. Rewrite the coefficient normalization for beta(phi squared minus v squared) squared/4; reduced wall energies are not fitted BaTiO3 material parameters.
先用稳定子区分等价方向与单畴操作，再选一对 180° 畴建立标量界面；48/8=: First use the stabilizer to distinguish equivalent directions from a single domain symmetry, then choose a 180-degree pair for a scalar interface. The count 48/8=6 gives orientation domains, not a wall width, and a scalar plus/minus v wall is not a full three-dimensional six-domain network.
先由局域势与梯度竞争求 tanh 尺度和固定边界，再积分额外壁能；分开驻点残差、: First obtain the tanh scale and fixed boundaries from the competition between local potential and gradient cost, then integrate the excess wall energy. Separate stationarity residuals, N versus 2N-1 grid errors on the same interval, and the Hessian after releasing the center constraint; a wider wall need not cost less energy.
先理解空间反号的序参量，再把概念转到独立、开放、无自旋 SSH 键二聚化界面；S: First understand a spatial sign change of an order parameter, then transfer that concept to a separate open spinless SSH bond-dimerization interface. SSH energies use eV and width uses bond spacings; do not copy a reduced phi-four wall width, and use subspace projectors to distinguish interface states from end states near zero energy.
先用完整 Hamiltonian 的生成元区分 SU(2) 与 XXZ/纵场保留: First use generators of the full Hamiltonian to distinguish SU(2) from the U(1) retained by XXZ exchange or a longitudinal field, then interpret uniform-rotation zero modes and gaps. The conservation model uses H/hbar; magnon J and h use meV with h=g mu_B B, not tesla. Retaining U(1) does not itself guarantee a zero mode of the selected reference state.
先固定 J>0、交换正负号、无量纲 S 与 XXZ 约定，再引入反向 A/B 子: First fix J>0, the exchange sign, dimensionless S and the XXZ convention, then introduce opposite A/B sublattices and opposite circular polarizations. Both use q=qa/pi, but the FM cell a and AFM cell 2a have different zone intervals; the non-Hermitian dynamical matrix is not an ordinary Hermitian band Hamiltonian.
先识别两子晶格偏振与 ±h 分裂，再比较低 q、零模、负能支和竞争经典态；实频不: First identify two-sublattice polarizations and the plus/minus h splitting, then compare low-q limits, zero modes, negative-energy branches and competing classical states. Real frequencies do not establish energetic stability; beyond the spin-flop threshold, the signed spectrum of the old Neel reference is not the excitation spectrum of the new canted ground state.
